title: Repair omitted source clauses in importer compiler projection
description: Follow-up from eshyra-o9bd.19.5.1.3 reconciliation. Audit the importer/compiler path for source clauses that are omitted or silently partially projected, repair the projection, and add source-grounded regression evidence. This is distinct from downstream engine execution integration.
close_reason: RETIRE/SUPERSEDE (2026-10-09 rebaseline, verified on main a961fb0b): superseded unbounded audit mandate. It originated in the pre-ADR reclassification of eshyra-o9bd.18.7 (369 records 'with likely mechanics but no typed projection'), which ADR 0020 no longer treats as a defect by itself. It names no concrete omitted clause. Concrete omission classes have owners: record/locator/segmentation completeness repaired by eshyra-o9bd.19.2.2 (PRs #571/#573/#574/#576/#578), known per-domain omissions by eshyra-o9bd.19.3.*/19.4.*, and discovery of new omissions by the independent audit eshyra-o9bd.16 (AC: attack known defect classes beyond the original examples). A concrete omission found later gets its own bead.
